body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics introduced its latest in mobile innovations at the pre-press conference during 2009 CES in Las Vegas.

"Delivering phones for all consumers is one of the most important aspects of our business. With the recent release of our first Windows based enterprise smartphone, we continue to push the envelope combining state-of-the-art features and flawless design to match every lifestyle," said Ehtisham Rabbani, vice president of product strategy and marketing for LG Mobile Phones. "For the music lovers, social texters or inspired photographers our award winning phones offer customized innovative technology for all ages and interests."
(Picture: Ehtisham Rabbani, vice president of product strategy and marketing, LG Mobile Phones)

Boasting the latest in cellular technology, the LG Incite is equipped with Windows Mobile 6.1 Professional, Microsoft Office Mobile and Microsoft ActiveSync 4.5. The Incite offers users Internet Explorer HTML Web Browsing, Windows Media Player 10, and is Wi-Fi Enabled for all their needs on-the-go. With a sleek bar design, crystal-clear 3-inch touch screen with vibration feedback, and a 3.0 megapixel camera and camcorder, users can send and enjoy all memories at the touch of a button.

This slider phone is the world's first phone to feature a discreet Bluetooth® hands-free headset integrated into the design. It also sports a five-way directional joystick for easy navigating through all of Verizon Wireless' multimedia.

Recipient of the prestigious Red Dot Design Award for its unique, chic and sleek form factor, the LG Lotus is the perfect combination of both style and substance. Offering One Click, a highly-customizable user interface that makes texting, Web access, email, Sprint Navigation, Sprint TV, Sprint Music StoreSM and other features easier to access. The Lotus has a full QWERTY keyboard that is ideal for quick text messaging, email or instant messaging. LG Lotus also boasts advanced features including stereo Bluetooth®, a 2.0 MP camera/camcorder and Wirele.

The LG Dare offers a large 3-inch touch screen that recognizes handwriting and provides tactile feedback. Tucked inside this V CAST-capable phone is a 3.2 mega pixel camera/camcorder with flash and Schneider-Kreuznach certified lens for outstanding image quality, and advanced features like face detection. The photo editing tool lets customers turn their photos into personal masterpieces with options that include borders, landscape and a fun doodle feature right on the screen. Customized photos can be uploaded to a social networking site directly from the phone.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, Jb Shim, Gini Shim >
